answer: The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The signal assignment is published and knoll records each panel. Shards are assigned from the spiral graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 3921 identities would post 3416 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
